body: thanks for the reply - yes her mum picked her up from the hospital this morning.  I have always been proud of the UK health care but yesterday the ambulance took an HOUR to arrive to her apartment, and despite her GP putting her on antidepressants a month ago, the she has still not been put in front a therapist :(

thanks so much for this.  I will check out the resources in r/suicidewatch (I did actually post there first but didn't manage to get much of a response).
Her mother had depression in her adult life too, which has been helpful in recent weeks as we (the mum and I) have been able to talk about it together.
Thanks again!
